description: Delivery commands owned by engineering procedures. Shipped only by the engineering package and evaluated by its `skill_router.py --package-routes` hook; each `command` regex matches one normalized simple command (bare program name, single spaces). The skill-routes contract owns the schema.

routes.note: open-pr owns the PR title and the ## Why / ## What body template.
Rewriting a PR title or body follows the same open-pr template.
merge owns the terminal-check, queue and cleanup loop; merge-docs' admin merge relies on it too.
A GraphQL enqueue or merge is a merge.
A REST PUT to a pull's merge endpoint is a merge.
handoff checkpoints the goal before a launcher transfers or side-launches work.
